transport: framed JSON-RPC 2.0 (u32 LE length prefix + UTF-8 JSON) over the unix socket at $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/nd-automation-<host-pid>.sock, gated on NATIVE_AUTOMATION=1

types.name: Geometry
types.doc: Logical units (not device pixels), relative to the window's top-left corner (coordinateSpace "logical-window-topleft").

types.name: RowJson
types.doc: SourceList's per-row shape on the wire (M11 SourceList Wave 1) — camelCase iconName, matching the schema prop shape.

types.name: JsonNode
types.doc: One tree-snapshot node. itemCount is ListView's row count (M5c-D4), null for every widget that isn't data-driven; rows is SourceList's ordered row data, null for every widget that isn't row-driven.

types.name: TypeResult
types.doc: text is the full text after the insert.

types.name: ScrollResult
types.doc: x/y are the resulting adjustment values.

types.name: WaitCondition
types.doc: Exactly one of textContains / refVisible must be set.

methods.name: getTree
methods.doc: Full tree snapshot with stable refs, testIDs, text, and logical geometry.

methods.name: screenshot
methods.doc: In-process render of the window to a PNG at the given absolute path; window (if given) must match the root ref.

methods.name: click
methods.doc: Actionability-checked semantic click; emits clicked exactly like real user input.

methods.name: waitFor
methods.doc: Polls the tree at ~50ms until the condition holds or timeoutMs elapses.

methods.name: setValue
methods.doc: Kind-dispatched: TextInput/TextArea need a string, Checkbox/Radio a bool, Slider a number, Select an integer index.

methods.name: type
methods.doc: TextInput only; semantic append via GtkEditable.insertText, never synthetic keysyms.

methods.name: scroll
methods.doc: ScrollView only — adjusts the wrapping GtkScrolledWindow's adjustments by dx/dy.

errors.name: invalidParams
errors.doc: data: {ref} where applicable; message may carry the specific missing/invalid param
